# Growing defence bonus earned while the country holds out in a war.
rpx_calc_valiant_baseline = {
	set_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_bonus = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rpx_dev_agricultural }
		add_to_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_bonus = 0.03 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rpx_char_landlocked }
		add_to_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_bonus = 0.03 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = rpx_char_militarized }
		add_to_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_bonus = 0.05 }
	}
}
